title: Chapter 159 Catch The Big Fish
content:
Chapter 159 Catch The Big Fish

Lu Xue's teasing immediately made Lei Yin blush.

He does have a bad temper.

But that depends on who he is facing.

The bloody lesson on the side has made this super god-level strongman who proves his way with thunder lose his temper.

After looking at Lei Yin for a long time, Lu Xue finally sighed.

"Remember, I don't like people who don't obey."

Hearing this, Lei Yin was relieved.

His life was finally saved.

But he still didn't regain his freedom.

Looking at Lu Xue's back, Lei Yin wanted to cry but had no tears.

However, what he didn't know was that many years later, he would feel extremely fortunate for his choice today!

"Princess, do you want to continue?"

At this time, Zhou Lao on the side reminded.

Hearing this, Lu Xue pondered for a moment and said, "It's too tiring to look for them one by one."

Then, Lu Xue stood in the center of the God Prison, and her voice spread throughout the God Prison.

"Those who want to fight against the alien races with our Divine Dynasty, now it can be said that they will miss this opportunity."

"Those who have made military achievements will be allowed to regain their freedom."

As soon as these words came out, the entire Divine Prison was shaken.

In less than a moment, countless strong men responded.

"I can still fight, let me out!"

"What a bullshit alien race, let me see what's going on!"

"My lord, I am willing to fight against the alien race!"

Seeing this, Lu Xue turned around and handed the prison guard an exquisite ring.

"Release these people who are willing to fight against the alien races, give them some resources, and let them restore their strength."

Hearing this, the prison guard took the ring and nodded quickly.

"Your Highness, just give it to me."

Lu Xue turned to look at Old Zhou again, and then smiled and said, "Old Zhou, please help me keep an eye on this place."

Old Zhou nodded without asking any more questions.

Then Lu Xue and Ao Qing left the Divine Prison first.

"Young Master, what are we going to do?"

Ao Qing suddenly said when they reached the outside of the God Prison.

At this time, Lu Xue stopped and turned to look at the entire God Prison.

"Of course, it's to catch big fish."

Hearing this, Ao Qing looked puzzled.

But not long after, he understood.

I saw a huge ancient bell covering the entire God Prison. Suddenly, there was a rumble, and the bell sounded, spreading throughout the entire capital of the Divine Dynasty.

"Huh? What is this?"

A puzzled voice came from the void.

The next moment, a sloppy but handsome man appeared in the void.

It was obvious that he was trapped in the Chaos Bell and could not leave the God Prison.

"Hello."

At this time, Lu Xue flew into the void and greeted the man across the chaos.

Seeing Lu Xue, the man frowned immediately.

"Did you do this?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue did not hide it.

"It's me. I'm here to prevent people like you who are not under control from taking the opportunity to escape from the God Prison."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, the man's face suddenly turned ugly.

"I advise you to open it immediately, otherwise, when I get out, you will be dead."

The man looked at Lu Xue and directly chose to threaten.

However, Lu Xue was indifferent.

"Do you want to escape so much? Don't you have any ideas about the alien race?"

The man had a blank expression, "That's your Divine Dynasty's business, it has nothing to do with me?"

Lu Xue frowned and said, "But their target is all the star fields, and then you can't escape."

"Hehe, so what, let's talk about it when your Divine Dynasty falls."

Looking at the other party's stubborn look, Lu Xue snorted coldly and said directly: "Give you two choices, either fight against the alien race, or die."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, the man burst into laughter.

"Do you think I'm the same as those trash in the Divine Prison?"

Boom!

Instantly, a terrifying breath rushed out of the man's body.

For a moment, the entire God Prison was completely shaken.

Half-step mortal realm!

(God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm, God-like realm)

There is actually a half-step mortal realm in the God Prison.

Because there is a Chaos Bell between them, Lu Xue and Ao Qing did not feel the pressure from the man very clearly.

But Ao Qing was still a little shocked.

Half-step mortal realm, this strength is not weak at all.

Now looking at the entire God Dynasty, no one can deal with a half-step mortal realm strongman.

But Lu Xue seemed to have known it for a long time, without a trace of surprise.

"No matter how powerful you are, are you as powerful as my mother?"

"Your mother?"

"The Queen of the God Dynasty."

Hearing the Queen of the God Dynasty, the man was silent.

The answer is obvious.

"The Soul Devouring Clan is not simple."

At this time, the man suddenly said.

"Do you know the Soul Devouring Clan?"

Lu Xue was a little surprised.

The man nodded, "Before your mother showed up, I was really not afraid of anyone."

"Then do you think I'm simple?"

Lu Xue asked.

"You?"

The man looked at Lu Xue and frowned.

At first, he just thought that Lu Xue was the daughter of that woman and her identity was not simple.

But after a closer look, he suddenly found that Lu Xue's luck seemed to be extremely deep.

This kind of luck, is it a person of destiny?

With the luck of the Great Dao, it is difficult for such a person to die.

"You are not simple either, but you have not grown up yet and cannot deal with the Spirit-Devouring Clan."

The man said directly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue's mouth twitched slightly.

What she wanted to say was that there was a father behind her.

And it is a truly invincible existence.

To be honest, if she called her dad now, there would be nothing to do with the Spirit-Devouring Clan.

But she didn't want to bother her father like this, because her father left, so she must have gone to do business. It's not good to bother now.

And at this moment, a huge shock suddenly came from the distant sky.

Almost at the same time, Lu Xue and the man looked in that direction suddenly.

At the same time, the entire Divine Dynasty emperor began to tremble.

A buzzing sounded.

A huge defensive barrier enveloped the entire imperial capital.

"Your Highness the Princess!"

A guard of the Divine Dynasty suddenly appeared beside Lu Xue.

"They are here!"

Lu Xue looked to the direction of the sky with a serious expression, and a darkness could be seen faintly.

Obviously a scene of black clouds swaying the city.

Is that the Spirit-Devouring Clan?

Lu Xue headed towards the direction of the city wall, and at this time, a man's cry suddenly came from behind.

"Wait a moment!"

Lu Xue turned her head, "What?"

The man sighed, "Think me."

I can't leave, and I have no other choice except to agree.

Hearing this, Lu Xue showed a smile. The next moment, Lu Xue waved her hand, and the Chaos Bell flew back to Lu Xue's hand.

"What level of divine thing are you?"

The man said curiously.

With his half-step mortal realm, he could not shake the ancient bell at all.

Looking at the man's curious gaze, Lu Xue said in a faint voice: "No level."

Then Lu Xue put away the Chaos Bell and a jade talisman appeared in her hand.

This is left to her by Lu Daosheng.

No matter where he is or whenever he is activated, Lu Daosheng will come immediately.

Looking at the jade talisman in his hand for a long time, Lu Xue finally shook her head slowly and then pulled it up.

It's time to do something myself.

However, Lu Xue did not notice that the moment she put away the jade talisman, the jade talisman suddenly trembled slightly for a moment.

.........

"I don't know how Lingyun Xiaoxue and the others have been doing for so long?"

"Oh, let's go back and take a look."

A figure rushed through the void and muttered to himself.

Around it are countless terrifying void turbulences.

Any one is enough to tear apart a world!
